method: Frozen same-question final JSON replay, actual alpha15 VoiceDirector before/after and current production Java integrity policy. Kotlin manager/history/TTS eligibility checked separately on JVM. No model regeneration or prompt changes.
rubric: Same six criteria, direct GPT reads edited outputs, unchanged labels reused. Known development questions/conditions, not independent or blind.
rules: Bounded exact current-question echo deletion; narrow leaked name-handling directives removed; dangling tail removed. Explicit repetition/quotes/code/URLs, decimal/structured text and sentence floors protected. Abstain if no substantive answer remains; no TTS/history for unusable_reply. No replacement facts or invented answer.
limitations: Lexical guards only, not general semantic entailment/completeness or leak detector. Abstention is not a successful answer. Next-turn quality and full APK/UI/TTS unverified.
